until: (() => { for (const p of s.people) if (p.status === 'queue' && p.chill) { s.selected = p.id; s.assign(Math.random() < 0.65 ? 0 : 1); } if (s.roof.selfieIn > 1) s.roof.selfieIn = 1; return s.people.some(p => p.selfie && p.selfie.stage === 'posing'); })()
after: const p = s.people.find(p => p.selfie && p.selfie.stage === 'posing'); const c = s.coach; c.x = 1.6; c.z = p.z - 1.6; c.wading = true; c.vx = 2; c.vz = 1; c.angle = Math.atan2(2, 1); return { focus: [p.x, 0, p.z], swimmers: s.people.filter(q => q.status === 'swim').length };
